full_prompt_en: A square fighting-game character illustration shows one full-length red-coated fighter standing against a clean white background. The white field is almost entirely blank, with no room, landscape, or supporting objects, and a faint gray contact shadow sits under the boots. The figure occupies the middle of the frame, leaving broad margins on both sides. A wide flat-brimmed black hat with a gold round emblem hides much of the upper face. Long pale hair projects outward beneath it, and a dark lower-face covering or deep collar obscures the mouth. The fighter wears a short red jacket with a high collar, angular shoulder and sleeve panels, and several round pale fasteners. Beneath it, a dark fitted torso layer meets a broad belt with an orange-red buckle. Large gray-brown trousers balloon at the thighs and narrow into cuffs above heavy orange-and-metallic boots. Several straps, pouches, loops, and hard-edged fittings hang from the waist and forearms. The hands, covered partly by dark gloves and metal guards, rest at either side of the body. Red coat tails flare outward behind the hips, forming sharp wing-like shapes that interrupt the otherwise upright stance. The feet stand apart, the right boot angled slightly outward, giving the pose a grounded readiness. Flat cel-like highlights and deep ink-black shadows divide the clothing into bold planar volumes. The light is bright and largely frontal, making the white ground even while small warm highlights catch the hat band, buckles, and boots. Fine sketchy strokes appear around seams and hard surfaces. There is no readable text. The overall composition is direct and character-focused, using a restricted red, charcoal, cream, and orange palette to make a complex silhouette immediately legible.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形格斗游戏角色插画呈现一位穿红外套的战士全身站立在干净白底前。白色色域几乎全空，没有房间、景观或支撑物，靴子下方只有一丝浅灰接触阴影。人物占据画面中部，两侧留出宽阔边距。平而宽的黑色帽檐带一枚金色圆徽，遮住上半张脸。浅色长发从帽下向外伸出，深色面部遮挡物或高领又藏住嘴部。战士穿短红外套，有高领、带棱角的肩袖色面和几枚浅色圆扣。下方贴身深色上衣接到宽皮带，扣环为橙红色。宽大的灰棕长裤在大腿处鼓起，向裤脚收窄，并接上厚重的橙色与金属色靴子。数根带子、小袋、环扣和硬边配件悬在腰间与前臂。双手部分被深色手套及金属护甲包住，垂在身体两侧。红色外套后摆从胯旁向外翻开，形成尖锐翅形，打断原本竖直的站姿。双脚分开，右靴稍向外转，使姿态稳稳待发。平坦的赛璐璐式高光与深墨黑阴影把衣服分成大胆的平面体积。光明亮且大体从正面来，让白底均匀，同时在帽带、扣具和靴子上留下细小暖高光。缝线与坚硬表面周围可见细碎草图式笔触。没有可读文字。整体构图直接以角色为中心，用受限的红、炭黑、乳白和橙色配色，使复杂剪影立即可辨。
style_prompt_en: The game-illustration style constructs readable forms from angular cel-like color planes, assertive dark outlines, and selective sketch texture. A nearly white ground gives high visual priority to the central silhouette, while a narrow contact shadow keeps it anchored. Deep charcoal masses interlock with brick red, muted cream, and small hot-orange accents; the warm notes are placed at repeated intervals to lead the eye vertically. Hard functional-looking surfaces receive crisp reflective edges, while softer folded areas are modeled by larger broken shapes. Protruding side panels and tapering lower elements create an energetic outline around a stable upright core. Bright even lighting leaves most of the white field untouched and pushes depth into a few dark interior recesses. Fine rough strokes around seams and transitions prevent the clean graphic structure from becoming sterile. The overall effect is bold, game-ready, and highly legible, with silhouette design and concentrated color contrast carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 这种游戏插画画风以带棱角的赛璐璐式色面、果断深色轮廓与选择性草图肌理构造易读形体。近白背景给予中央剪影很高的视觉优先级，狭窄接触阴影则让它稳住。深炭色大形与砖红、低饱和乳白和少量炽橙重音交锁；暖色重音按不同高度重复布置，引导目光竖向移动。坚硬且具功能感的表面获得清晰反光边，较柔软的折叠区域则以更宽大破碎的形状塑造。外伸侧面色片与向下渐收的形体在稳定竖向核心外制造有力轮廓。明亮均匀的照明让白色色域大部分保持原样，把纵深压入少数深色内部凹处。缝合与转折周围的细碎粗笔痕避免干净图形结构显得无菌。整体效果大胆、适合游戏视觉且高度易读，剪影设计与集中的色彩反差承载画风。
theme_en: A red-coated fighter in a wide hat standing against white
theme_zh: 一位穿红外套、戴宽檐帽的战士立在白底前
